entries.name: Wickerjaw
entries.prompt: FIELD01 WICKERJAW. Original small fantasy creature species for a serious medieval RPG, Fallowmarch heathland seed thief and burrow hunter. Anatomical design, not a real animal wearing fantasy decoration. Four balanced muscular legs, broad three-toed gripping paws, an oval torso of moderate thickness, a short flattened balancing tail. Its unmistakable head has a horizontally divided hard seed-cracking lower bill under a soft short muzzle, two small deep-set amber eyes, a pair of low swept-back folded sensory fins instead of mammal ears. Mature alert neutral expression. Fine russet and peat-brown velvet hide with dark branching freckle patterns, ochre worn bill edges, cream throat folds. Healthy and well fed but athletic, neither bulky nor skinny; ordinary sized head and feet. No horns, spikes, glowing parts, armor, fox ears, cat face, cute eyes or smile. Art direction of a grounded Knight Online or RuneScape creature designed by a human concept artist: simple legible silhouette, restrained fantasy, intentional anatomy. One creature only, full body three-quarter view, all four feet visible and separated for 3D rigging, standing naturally with tail clear of legs. Neutral light gray background, soft even studio light, realistic painted material detail, no pedestal, no text.

audit.reason: Furred dinosaur reading from beaked head, reptilian legs and tail. Replace with upright woodland being with broad non-beaked face and grasping hands.

entries.name: Hedge Clasper
entries.prompt: FIELD02 HEDGE CLASPER. Original woodland ambush creature species for a serious medieval RPG. A living terrestrial plant predator that prunes invasive thickets. Balanced low four-legged body, each limb a supple rooted tendon of moderate thickness with three short gripping digits; a compact deep green trunk body with flexible ribbed growth seams. Head is a clean tapered seed-pod shape opening sideways at two fleshy hinged jaw lobes lined with small inward woody teeth. Two tiny dark sensory pits on upper pod. No human face. Its defining silhouette is one graceful curved dorsal leaf shielding its spine, not a forest of random spikes. Bark-green leathery plant skin with overlapping reddish-brown cambium scars, mossy olive mottling, fresh ochre bud tissue around joint folds; layered surface colors, alive and thriving. Muscular balanced proportions, not squat tank, not thin insect or stick creature. Serious and watchful, no horror rot, no skull, no cute mascot, no glowing veins, no horns. Readable classic Knight Online and RuneScape RPG style, individually designed anatomy rather than animal with decoration. Full body three-quarter view, four feet separated, mouth only slightly open, clear limb connections, neutral pale gray background, soft flat studio light, no base, no text.

audit.reason: Long toothy reptile head, arched dinosaur neck and clawed quadruped posture. Redesign as upright rooted pitcher plant with radial opening, stalk arms and broad root feet.

referenceReview.reason: Long toothy reptile head, arched dinosaur neck and clawed quadruped posture. Redesign as upright rooted pitcher plant with radial opening, stalk arms and broad root feet.

entries.name: Bramble Tiller
entries.prompt: FIELD03 BRAMBLE TILLER. Original healthy woodland guardian species for a serious medieval RPG. Living root organism with a non-human four-legged anatomical design, not a man made of bark. Balanced muscular quadruped built around a horizontal arched root crown; four proportionate jointed root legs with broad divided digging pads, a short upward neck carrying a smooth wedge-shaped greenwood sensory head with two recessed dark amber eyes and a small beak-like split. Two curved flat hoe-shaped growths grow from its forearms for clearing soil, modest in size. The body is compact but not chunky, legs weight-bearing and neither thin nor stubby. Spring green cambium under warm gray-brown bark, fine layered lichen patches, reddish old growth edges and pale scraped wear on digging pads; only a few small fresh leaf shoots on shoulders. Distinct deliberate silhouette, no random antlers, no tree crown on head, no human face, no skull, no scifi armor, no smile or large eyes. It tends forest clearings and becomes dangerous when its root beds are harmed. Serious grounded Knight Online and RuneScape concept-art sensibility. One full-body creature at three-quarter angle, all four legs visible apart for rigging, clean neutral gray backdrop, diffuse material lighting, no environment or text.

audit.reason: Pointed beaked head and long neck read as dinosaur and repeat animal chassis. Redesign upright bramble worker with short trunk face, branch arms and root legs.

referenceReview.reason: Pointed beaked head and long neck read as dinosaur and repeat animal chassis. Redesign upright bramble worker with short trunk face, branch arms and root legs.

entries.name: Knotwarden
entries.prompt: FIELD04 KNOTWARDEN. Original ancient woodland creature for a serious medieval RPG, a living fallen-bough guardian with purposeful unusual anatomy. Four evenly proportioned articulated limbs support a gently arched cylindrical trunk body, medium solid build with clear flexible joints; forward pair end in curved split root hands, hind pair in grounded rounded root feet. A single hollow resonating knot sits at the front of its short neck as its head, oblique natural oval opening with a small living amber bud inside, no face, no human eyes or nose. Rounded shoulders formed by old growth curls, flexible greenwood tendon joints, modest curved tail-like root for balance. Sound from the knot warns the forest of fire. Healthy timber with walnut brown grain, honey colored exposed knots, muted green lichen islands and fine pale moss fibers; limited fresh foliage tucked into upper growth seams. This is a living organism not a dead tree monster. Neither huge blocky golem nor skeletal branch stick figure. No horns, no spikes, no robot masks, no glowing fissures, no skull or ribs, no cute expression. Restrained hand-designed classic RPG look with Knight Online and RuneScape readability. Full body three-quarter natural standing riggable pose, all four limbs separated, soft gray background, even light, no pedestal, no text.

audit.reason: Hollow knot face and root hands establish distinct fantasy being. Living shoots and lichen, solid readable wooden anatomy.

entries.name: Fallow Brute
entries.prompt: FIELD05 FALLOW BRUTE. Serious medieval RPG plains ogre, original mature humanoid species inspired by early Knight Online creature readability. Tall but balanced muscular adult, believable six-and-a-half head proportions, a broad but not barrel-shaped torso, ordinary length strong legs and long capable arms ending in normal sized four-finger hands. A low forehead, small steady eyes, flat broad nose, thick closed lips and one short lower tusk on either side; calm wary expression, not grotesque or cute. Warm clay-brown skin with leathery callus pads on shoulders and knuckles, sparse dark hair in a short rough scalp strip, faint ochre clan pigment rubbed into old skin creases. Wears a practical plain woven flax waist wrap and a single fitted leather belt with a small seed pouch, no armor and no weapon so animation can use separate props. It lives at grassland edges and guards grain stores. Distinct face with natural organic planes, no horns, no scifi mask, no giant belly, no oversized fists, no skinny legs, no skulls, no ornamental clutter or glowing eyes. Healthy neutral ecology creature, game-ready readable silhouette and hand-painted skin detail. Full body front three-quarter relaxed A pose, fingers slightly apart, feet planted apart, neutral gray background, diffuse lighting, no base or text.
